items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I think Harry Goodman was on base.

ctx.x: Yes, Teddy Wilson's orchestra. And it featured Boots Castle, and who else was on that -- I think Harry Goodman was on base.
: Oh yeah, Harry was Benny's brother.
And I know one of the songs she sang, 'The Hour of Parting' -- it was a double -- a single record, double size.
